simple_fishing_overhaul.config.catchRadi: Radius in blocks around the bobber in which fish can be caught.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueC: Chance for fish to get intrigued by the bobber and move towards it. The Lure enchantment increases this chance by up to two times.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueR: Radius around the bobber where fish can become intrigued by it. The Lure enchantment increases this radius by up to two times.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.fishDropN: Prevents fish which were killed by the player from dropping any loot.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.allowFish: Allows fishing in waters with no fish inside to obtain junk or treasure.
